what: The upload of the packed search input from pinned (page-locked, cached) host memory, priced before building it. A probe build of 868614f (engine and evaluator; not committed) copies the packed input into a pinned staging buffer of the search, waits on an event of its last upload before writing it again, and uploads from there when OMNIMD_PINNED_UPLOAD=1 (`on`); otherwise it uploads from the pageable vector as before (`off`, twice a round: `off_again` against `off` shows what the machine adds). Five rounds, the order reversed every other round, the least and the median of each. Evaluations (--bench) of the three HAP frames of the engine benchmarks (3,000) and of the 88-atom frame replicated to 5,632 atoms (300) with the trained se_e2_a model in float32 with tables; of the water frames of 1,536 (300) and 12,288 atoms (60) with the water model in float64; NVT MD of the three HAP frames, 20,000 steps of 0.5 fs (us a step). Not built. By the least time, the evaluations of the HAP frames took 4.3 to 7.1 us longer with pinned memory while `off_again` was within 2.6 us of `off`; the MD steps took 5.6 to 10.6 us longer, with `off_again` up to 7.6 us from `off` (169 atoms); for thousands of atoms the differences were about those of the control.
